I am a mathematics PhD student working with
[Amie Wilkinson](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~wilkinso/) at the University of
Chicago. My interests are in dynamical systems and analysis.

I currently work in smooth ergodic theory, on the dimension theory of random
diffeomorphisms. The basic question there is how the dimension of invariant and
stationary measures is determined by Lyapunov exponents and entropy.

I have also worked on harmonic analysis, descriptive set theory, and function
spaces arising in PDE, including a scale of anisotropic Sobolev spaces adapted
to traveling wave problems.
